newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks close down on cross deals, banks.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks close down on cross deals, banks.

text.p: Colombian stocks closed down in trading marked by pocket-to-pocket cross deals and profit- taking in banks.

Medellin's IBOMED general price index finished down 0.51 percent to 18.208.39 on volume of 4.1 billion pesos. Bogota's IBB price index dipped 0.34 percent to 1,197.31 on above average volume of 11.8 billion pesos.
Traders said hours of uncertainty following the removal Thursday of the nation's top military officer had not had a significant impact on the market.
Markets dipped, however, on large pocket-to-pocket cross deals in Medellin and speculative profit taking in Bogota, they said.
The Bogota index fell on losses in Banco de Bogota, which closed down 1.42 percent to 6,900.
Banco Ganadero also numbered among Bogota's losers finishing down 1.22 percent to 402 in Bogota.
A large pocket-to-pocket cross deal in cement maker Compania de Cemento Argos pushed the stock down 2.43 percent in Medellin to 8,150, while it held at 8,635 in Bogota.
Argos's first-half net earnings fell 47 percent to 26.6 billion pesos compared with the first-half last year, quarterly reports show.
Cementos del Caribe fell 1.66 percent to 5,900 in Bogota and 2.66 percent to 5,850 in Medellin.
